in_hebrew.name: חגית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חגית היא שם גברי המקורו ביוונית, ובעברית פירושו פרח נוקב, מבורך, נחמד.  באסלאפונטה ובתרגומים שונים, השם חגית נשמע כגרסה יהודית של השם היווני.  במסורת הנוצרית, השם חגית נקשר לאדם ספורדי, שיורשו היה האפיפיור גליקריוס הראשון.  בהקשר הנוצרי, השם חגית עשוי לסמל נבואה, חסד, ואדם מאושר.

in_greek.name: Ἰακίνθη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἐστὶ ὄνομα πρῶτον ἐν τῇ Βιβλίῳ τῶν Ἀποστόλων, καὶ ἕτερον ὄνομα πρῶτον ἐν τῇ Παλαιᾷ Διαθήκῃ. Πρῶτος καρπός, πρῶτος φύων, Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἐστὶ πρῶτος πᾶσι τοῖς ὀνόμασιν τῆς Βίβλου. Λέγεται, ὅτι ὁ Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἦν ὁ πρῶτος, ὅστις ἔπλασεν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν, καὶ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ τὴν φυῆ. Ἀπὸ τούτου, ὁ Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἐξήγησε τὴν ὁσιότητα καὶ τὴν αὐτοσυνειδησία, καὶ ἀπὸ τούτου, ὁ Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἐξήγησε τὴν πίστιν. Ἀπὸ τούτου, ὁ Ἰακίνθη (Ἰακίνθη) ἐξήγησε τὴν δόξαν, καὶ τὴν ἀξιοπρέπειαν.

in_latin.name: Hyacinthus
in_latin.meaning: Primus color, primus flos, primus cultus
in_latin.long_meaning: Hyacinthus est nomen primus in Biblia, et alterum nomen primus in Veteri Testamento. Primus color, primus flos, primus cultus, Hyacinthus est primus omnibus nominibus Bibliae. Dicitur, quod Hyacinthus fuit primus, qui formavit animam suam, et suam naturam. Ab eo, Hyacinthus explicavit sanctitatem, et conscientiam, et ab eo, Hyacinthus explicavit fidem. Ab eo, Hyacinthus explicavit gloriam, et dignitatem.

in_english.name: Hyacinth
in_english.meaning: first flower, first gift, first fruit, first love
in_english.long_meaning: Hyacinth is a name of Christian origin, derived from the Greek word 'hyakinthos', meaning first flower, first gift, first fruit, first love.  In the Bible, Hyacinth is associated with a person named Hyacinth, a nephew of the Emperor Theodosius.  In the Christian tradition, the name Hyacinth is said to symbolize prophecy, charity, and a happy soul.  As a name, Hyacinth is often associated with qualities such as kindness, humility, and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hyacinth, with its Greek origins and association with the color purple, has historically been connected with royalty and wealth. In medieval Europe, lavender (derived from hyacinth) and violets (the traditional color of purple) were often used to adorn the clothes and furniture of the nobility, adding a regal touch. The name, therefore, carried the connotations of refinement and elegance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hyacinth, besides its associations with royalty and wealth, has deeper spiritual meanings. The Christian faith places a great emphasis on the spiritual journey towards God, who is our true and ultimate reward. The name Hyacinth, with its reference to the purple color, can symbolize this spiritual journey – the striving for purity of heart and mind towards God. In the old tradition, the color purple was associated with penance, royalty, and spiritual significance. Thus, the name Hyacinth can serve as a reminder for us to continue on this spiritual journey, striving for purity and closeness to God, our true King and Kingdom.
